escena: SCENE (post-production suite, the editor finds the exact frame for a client's launch video): in focus, a video editor in a plain olive overshirt leans in CLOSE to a large colour-grading monitor, caught at the exact moment the index finger touches the timeline on the screen; the monitor is the brightest thing in the frame and its cool light lifts the editor's face and hand. A small lime-green sticky note on the monitor's edge; one plain azure-blue (#0375DB) coffee mug on the desk carries the only blue. Behind, soft and out of focus, acoustic panels in dark grey felt. 85mm f/1.8. LENS FRAMING (essential, compact): the editor's face, the pointing finger and the monitor are CLOSE TOGETHER, all three inside ONE circle whose diameter is about 75% of the frame height, centred at 74% of the frame width and at 56% of the frame height, with air around it; nothing essential outside that circle. The LEFT 45% of the frame holds only calm, evenly shadowed dark grey acoustic felt. Nobody looks at the lens. Screen content is soft, abstract colour, no readable text or numbers, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the dark rubber edge of the editing desk right at the lens

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed dark grey acoustic felt
